Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: Manage your ledger preferences and account settings
Settings.accountAndSecurityDesc: Manage your email and account security
Settings.themeDescription: Set the color mode for the current interface
Settings.uiLanguageDesc: Set the UI language for the current user
Settings.aiLanguageDesc: Makes AI-generated titles, item names, adjustments, and notes natural for native speakers of this language without limiting the receipt's original language
Settings.mainCurrencyDesc: Used for statistics and totals; changing it recalculates history at transaction-date rates.
Settings.mainCurrencyChangeDescription: The main currency will change to {currency}. Historical totals and converted amounts for current and pending entries will be recalculated using transaction-date rates. Original amounts and currencies will not change.
Settings.timeZoneDesc: Used for default dates, ranges, and statistics. Existing entry dates do not change.
Settings.collapseEntriesDesc: Start with each record's details collapsed in the stream.
Settings.preferredCurrenciesDesc: List of currencies used in this ledger.
Settings.categoriesDesc: Manage expense categories and their order in this ledger.
Settings.deleteCategoryDescription: Delete the category {name}? Its entries will become uncategorized.
Settings.aiPromptDesc: Add parsing, categorization, and writing rules for this ledger. These can override default title style and content organization, but cannot override the output language or hard constraints.
Settings.aiPromptPlaceholder:
e.g.:
• Split service fees into a separate item
• Classify taxi as Transport
• Use concise merchant-first titles
Settings.pushNotificationsDesc: Receive real-time updates when your bills are processed.
Settings.notificationPermissionDenied: Permission denied. Please enable notifications in your browser settings.
Settings.updateFailed: Update failed. Please try again later.
Settings.ratesUnavailable: Historical rates are missing for some transaction dates. The main currency was not changed.
Settings.unsupportedCurrency: The selected currency is not supported by the exchange-rate data.
Settings.validationFailed: The settings are invalid. Check them and try again.
Settings.updateConflict: The settings changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
Settings.uncategorizedDesc: {count} {count, plural, one {entry} other {entries}} not yet categorized
Settings.signOutDesc: Sign out of your current account
